evidence: Scoped to workbook check 18: the reference plausibly satisfies all 88 actual criteria (2 gates, 74 functional, 6 polish, 6 visual). This is reference-coverage evidence, not a configured Oracle result. Read the criteria themselves, their scenario protocols, and reference implementation. The workbook/internal row has no extra annotation changing this standard. Source and run binding: recomputed and matched all 102 current_golden and 5 current_source_checks artifact SHA256 values in the current index; also matched all 22 actual_app_files in golden/run-golden-20261001-051714/RESULTS.json to the frozen reference, plus its functional judge and prompt hashes. RESULTS.json SHA256 c7e553fb3c51a25f29e60ef1d417f3471547c0b37e4b1887d4c2f8eeee97050d. Its facts contain fresh observations for all 74 functional owners, with no missing fact keys. Individual observed fields, marker outputs, errors, timings and readbacks were inspected, rather than treating the summary pass flag as proof. Coverage mapping: solution/app/src/app.tsx:53,62,100,127,134,143,148-166 supplies startup/examples, new/save/load, the CodeMirror editor, 500ms cancellable debounce, console inspection/history/clear, themes and named keyboard controls (S01, S14-S19, S21, S23, S34 and Polish). Runtime.ts:23-67,69-277,299-389 supplies filename dispatch, fresh isolated frames, source instrumentation, error/rejection locations, console values, last-good snapshots including live form values, cancellation, shared deadlines and later recovery (S02-S13, S36). Server.js:41-88,111-131 validates trimmed unique case-sensitive titles and revisions and stores exact source in SQLite at DB_PATH; source is never executed there (S21-S24 and Constraints). Concrete product observations: S02 has authored js-dispatch-ok/html-dispatch-ok and an independent CSS sample coloured rgb(255,0,0)/rgb(1,2,3). S03 records later click/key/input after both six-second intervals, then Stop retaining input value a without new old-handler counts. S04 records the successful 4000ms callback control, replacement fresh run-B-undefined, pending Stop restoring that render and subsequent recovery. S08 separately records all five unsupported-family refusals after ordinary-word/local-binding controls. S09 finite controls produce 3/4/3; three infinite runs show time-limit errors around 4.9 seconds and restored timeout-control. S10-S13 record forEeach line 4, undefinedFunctionCall line 6, JS/HTML timer lines 2/6 and Error/plain-string/HTML rejection lines 2/2/6; last-good visible fields and later DOM/log recovery are present. S36 records nested-control-done, outer late-callback-entered, five-second timeout without inner completion during the ten-second window, restored baseline and later recovery. S05 and S07 record actual successful own-document/transport controls, blocked parent accesses, no additional external deliveries, and final recovery. Console/editor/autorun observations include expandable nested-value and [11,22,33], actual four-level order, append/clear behavior, short versus 4008.6ms delayed completion, terminal durations, populated monospace/gutter/three-language syntax, 560ms automatic execution and reset-on-edit final execution, off/queued-off three-second idle windows plus deliberate Run controls. Library observations include distinct exact records, browser reload, a single successful canonical restart with pid 16 to 347, whole-collection readback and five unchanged example choices, advanced current Save revision, two role-reversed stale refusals retaining exact dirty title/filename/source, deliberate reapplication under the same identity, trimmed creation/update, creation/update collision/empty refusals with unchanged records and case-distinct coexistence. Surface-results.json records authored Render output, an independent clean-context saved record/readback, actual keyboard traversal of all 11 requested controls with visible outlines, correct example/saved source navigation and mobile edit/Run/Clear. The source and these observations support the gate/polish bars. Desktop dark/light and mobile captures show coherent three-pane composition, clear typography/contrast, consistent controls and sensible stacked adaptation; all six visual criteria can plausibly score high, without assigning a judge grade. A follow-up isolated no-network probe was coordinated with the owner because two older surface captures visually omitted preview text despite retained DOM text. Frozen files were mounted readonly and copied to a disposable unprivileged app/DB in the pinned verifier image; no host ports or provider calls. row18-probe/result.json reports exit 0. All 22 copied files match the frozen source. Its light-300ms.png and light-2300ms.png visibly retain the initial preview, dark-return.png retains it after the second theme change, and mobile-viewport.png visibly shows the preview/console after normal scrolling. observations.json records unchanged body text and visible computed styles throughout. The suspected theme loss did not reproduce; no source-coverage defect was established. Raw probe artifact hashes are in row18-probe/hashes.json. Limits: the current artifacts explicitly do not measure full configured judge workload, Oracle grade, target-model score or empirical configured reward ordering. This Pass is only the workbook's plausible reference coverage; it does not clear those separate required runtime measurements or promise a portal outcome.
counterexample: Attempted weak-app reasoning: a static editor/screenshot or localStorage-only mock cannot meet authored DOM plus console execution and independent clean-context server retrieval; an implementation that refuses all timers/loops cannot use absence to satisfy cancellation/deadline criteria because actual 4000ms and finite-loop controls are required. The reference observations include those controls. Attempted conforming-alternative reasoning: a static restored snapshot after Stop/error, alternate CSS sample, lowercase-only extension support, native control styling and a different editor escape sequence are explicitly permitted by the actual criteria/prompts. The reference uses the permitted static snapshot and CodeMirror Escape/Tab behavior; neither needs a hidden extra requirement. No concrete criterion the golden cannot satisfy was identified.
